description: Issue #899 root cause: all 10 WalkingTec.Mvvm.WorkFlow ITenant entities (including ProcessDefinition) never received the global tenant/soft-delete query filter, because ApplyWorkFlowModels() registers WorkFlow entity types into the EF model AFTER FrameworkContext.OnModelCreating's Pass 2 loop (DataContext.cs) has already finished applying the ITenant filter -- so the filter was never actually enforced through any standard FrameworkContext-derived app, including the framework's own demo. This mutant deletes the ApplyWorkFlowTenantFilter<ProcessDefinition>(builder, context) call added to ApplyWorkFlowModels(ModelBuilder, EmptyContext) to fix that, reproducing the exact pre-fix behaviour for this one entity: a context scoped to tenant B can read tenant A's ProcessDefinition row, with the generated SQL carrying no TenantCode predicate at all. Checked against TenantFilterInvariantTests.ProcessDefinition_TenantB_CannotSeeTenantA_Row, which seeds a ProcessDefinition row under TenantA and asserts a context scoped to TenantB cannot resolve it -- with the mutant applied, that read succeeds and the assertion fails. The green control, ProcessDefinition_TenantA_CanSeeOwnRow, seeds a ProcessDefinition row under TenantA and asserts TenantA's own context can still read it -- proving the mutation does not have broader collateral effects (e.g. breaking the Wf_ProcessDefinition table registration itself). Mirrors the #862 ETL precedent (test/mutants/entries/etl862-applyetlmodels-tenantfilter-neutralize.json) exactly: same red+positive-control test-pair shape, one module over.

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.WorkFlow.Test.TenantFilt: #899: a context scoped to TenantB must NOT resolve TenantA's ProcessDefinition row

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Captured verbatim against the committed baseline (bin-relative stale demo.db checked for and absent; mutant patch applied via git apply, test run, then reverted via git apply -R): "Assert.IsFalse failed. #899: a context scoped to TenantB must NOT resolve TenantA's ProcessDefinition row. If this fails, ApplyWorkFlowModels(ModelBuilder, EmptyContext) is no longer applying the ITenant query filter for ProcessDefinition." Confirmed via python3 test/mutants/run_mutant.py --mutant wf899-applyworkflowmodels-processdefinition-tenantfilter-neutralize: 'VERDICT: KILLED' / 'GATE: PASS'.
